name: comp-504

frames.best_why: Month chooser is open with 2026 expanded and November filled, the feature the day views lack.

tagline: Calendar caption opens a collapsible list of years and months.
summary: A compact month calendar whose heading is a button: pressing it swaps the day grid for a scrollable run of years, each opening into a three-across grid of month buttons. Picking a month returns to the days.
appearance: A small bordered black panel shows the month name with a chevron, dim angle arrows, a weekday row and five rows of day numbers. Overlaid, the same panel becomes a stack of year rows, the open year showing twelve rounded month buttons in three columns.
behaviour: Pressing the month heading covers the days with the year list and rotates its chevron. Each year row expands or folds; tapping a month closes the list and drops back to that month's days, as November gives way to March in the frames.
demo_content: November 2026 with 14 selected, a year list open at 2026, then March 2026.
search_phrases: calendar where you jump to any month
click the month name to choose a year
jump quickly to an old month
date picker with a month grid overlay
choose a month from a list of years
scroll through years to pick a month
use_when: People jump far back or forward in time and picking a month and year beats paging month by month.
avoid_when: The jump list only covers 1980 to 2030, so dates outside that span can never be reached.
customise: The 1980-2030 year span, starting month and caption link are set in the file; month labels and single-date mode come from the shared calendar.
weight_why: One month grid plus a scrollable list of 51 years; no continuous animation.

a11y.note: Year rows report aria-expanded and days are buttons, but the month heading never says it opens a chooser.

issues: The caption button gives no hint that it opens a month chooser.
The year list is fixed to 1980-2030 with no way to widen it.
The caption credits the calendar library instead of describing the picker.
polish_why: Tidy month grid and a neat year accordion; the mute caption toggle and library credit stop it short.
title: Advanced Year Month Picker
